title: Witness Couplet

principles: Reality remains greater than the system's account of it.
Coherence is selected through relation, consequence, correction, and time.
New meaning appears through witnessed relations and relation grammars.
Desire for emergence is never evidence that emergence has occurred.

authority.claims: The utterance composes a human-confirmed observation and a declared relation under a versioned grammar.
authority.doesNotClaim: The utterance exhausts the image, proves intention, or supplies the final meaning of the witnessed event.

privacy: Image bytes remain in the browser and are excluded from exported witnesses.
